column1: # Held-out Revit 2018 to 2021 projects with the same release's own IFC export, redistributable,
# measured before any fix is made for them (#408, W5; found through #1261, reported by
# @inevitable-co-ai; Griffin, 2026-11-03: hold them out, develop on Autodesk's sample projects).
# Fetched with `-f holdout=true` by tools/ci/fetch-holdout-archives.sh into the held-out folder,
# never committed, and, like the other held-out models, only their summary counts are uploaded
# (tools/ci/scrub-holdout-results.sh), so that no rule is tuned on what they hold.
# - BIM-Speed demonstration projects (TU Berlin DepositOnce, "BIM-Speed Demonstration Projects -
#   BIM and BEM models", doi:10.14279/depositonce-16441, CC BY 4.0, credit the BIM-Speed project):
#   - Vitoria, "ALD26 Before" and "ALD26 Project": Revit 2018 (build 20190510_1515), exported by
#     the same release's exporter 18.4 as IFC2X3 Coordination View 2.0. One building before and
#     after its renovation.
#   - Frigento, "Modello palazzo Testa_Cipriano": Revit 2020 (build 20190327_2315), exporter
#     20.0.0.377, IFC4 Design Transfer View.
#   - Gdynia, "RO_18" with "RUCHU OPORU 18.ifc": exporter 21.0.0.383 (Revit 2021), IFC2X3
#     Coordination View 2.0; RO_18_IN and RO_18_EL in the same folder are its MEP models.
#   - Warmond, the baseline model with "ar.ifc": exporter 21.0.0.383 (Revit 2021), IFC4, then
#     passed through BIMServer.center's IFC Preprocessor, so its values are counted apart.
# - BIM Whale's "AdvancedProject" (andrewisen/bim-whale-ifc-samples, MIT, "feel free to use these
#   files however you like"): the Revit 2021 project its README links, and the IFC2X3 Coordination
#   View 2.0 export by exporter 21.1.10.26 in the repository at b6d0d88a.
# Vitoria's "ALD26 Before" is spent (2026-11-03): held out, it exported no element against Revit's
# 1,394, while every Autodesk 2018 sample exports its elements, so the cause shows on no sample and,
# as Griffin's rule allows, this pair is measured in full to find it. "ALD26 Project", the same
# building after its renovation, stays held out as the check.
# An archive is pinned whole, and each member again after extraction under the name given here (a
# name under spent/ is a pair measured in full, no longer held out).
